name: Card Atlas
description: Browse the community's character cards without leaving the app: search nine hubs — Character Tavern, RisuRealm, Chub, Wyvern, AI Character Cards, CharaVault, BotBooru, Pygmalion, Datacat — with real cover art, each hub's own sort menu, tag and content-rating filters, a full per-card stat sheet, and add any card straight to your library — art and all, provenance-stamped, dedupe-aware.
author: Orbweaver
